dataset: OSM public background context for design review v2

query.summary: Bounded Overpass query for ways tagged highway, railway, building, park, selected green land uses, water or waterway, plus nodes tagged as rail/public-transport stations or subway entrances; output body geometry; users and changeset metadata not requested.

steps: Request bounded public OSM data without users or changeset metadata.
Use Overpass way geometry directly; convert station and entrance nodes to Point features.
Clip to the recorded bbox and classify features as roads, buildings, rail, green_water, or stations from OSM tags.
Preserve OSM type and identifier; mark every derived feature background_only and not_official.
Do not use the dataset to derive, revise, validate, or replace project or key-area boundaries.

use_limitations: Background context only; OSM is volunteer-maintained and has variable completeness and positional accuracy.

Not an official boundary, statutory planning control, road redline, engineering alignment, heritage-control line, ownership record, precise-area source, accessibility-compliance audit, or approved implementation commitment.
Not a basis for deriving, revising, validating, or replacing the repository provisional project boundary or key-area geometry.
Any later distribution of a derivative database requires separate ODbL attribution and share-alike review.
